KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. fupi
   D. zito

   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
